_doc: The ONE terminal-approval source. A row is a FAMILY (id, cmd, why); each platform's exact rule text comes from render:{zoo,claude,antigravity} when present, else is DERIVED from cmd by the platform's grammar (permission_render.py). only:/not: scope a row. grant: read_file makes the row a FILE grant (rendered as read_file(<dir>), recursive over everything under it, Antigravity only) instead of a command one - SCC-387. Rendered by /smh-sync-agents; drift is red in tests/test_permission_parity.py. Identical DECISIONS across platforms, never identical bytes (SCC-378). house_twin_prefix: every Antigravity deny is also rendered behind the house command shape `cd <abs> && ...` (command-shape.md rule 1), because the vendor documents per-token matching on the leading tokens and nothing about chains - the twin fences the shape either way (code review 2026-09-03).

Antigravity auto-allows reads INSIDE the workspace and asks for everything outside it, and Claude Code's memory store is outside it. Five 'always allow' clicks on 2026-09-03 bought five single files, and the apply would have erased all five (it REPLACES both arrays). A directory grant is recursive over everything under it, so this one row retires them (SCC-387). Machine-scoped by construction - the Mac's own store path is its own row, in SCC-382.

SCC-410 (cycle 10): `env -C <dir> <cmd>` and `env --chdir=<dir> <cmd>` run the command somewhere else entirely and nothing downstream sees the flag, so the wrapper launders a destructive command past a fence written for the bare one. Measured 2026-09-04 on this base: the wrapper read `ask` on all three platforms, and PR #165 shipped a single `Bash(env -C:*)` allow row that auto-approved `env -C <dir> rm -rf /` through a fully green battery. DENY-side only - it can never grant. Claude renders nothing here: it carries no deny list at all, and battery A3 is its guard. Both spellings and both flag shapes (`-C /tmp`, `-C/tmp`, `--chdir /tmp`, `--chdir=/tmp`) plus the env -u twin; the `cd <abs> && ` house twins are added by the render pass.
